description: This Java source file contains test cases for the CCServices class, used to test interactions with ClearCommerce payment processing services within the OFBiz framework. It includes setup code for test data and methods for testing authorization, credit, subscription purchase, report querying, and placeholders for subscription management.

classes.name: CCServicesTest
classes.description: A JUnit test case class for testing ClearCommerce payment services within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data including mock credit card, address, and order information before each test execution.

methods.name: testAuth
methods.description: Tests the authorization process for a payment transaction.

methods.name: testCredit
methods.description: Tests the credit (refund or deduction) process for a credit card.

methods.name: testPurchaseSubscription
methods.description: Tests purchasing a subscription with specified order and credit details.

methods.name: testFreeSubscription
methods.description: Placeholder for testing free subscription; currently not implemented.

methods.name: testCancelSubscription
methods.description: Placeholder for canceling a subscription; processing typically handled outside the code, via admin tools.

methods.name: testCCReport
methods.description: Tests querying of a specific credit card transaction report.
